thread:
sam_dev: Heads up — after upgrading the JS SDK to 2.3.0 our onboarding sample app fails when deployed to the edge runner. Error is `Cannot find module` in runtime and TS complains about missing types. Repro steps: bump package, deploy to edge.

mira_ts: ugh. seen similar. likely an `exports` map regression — edge runtimes pick the wrong entry (or nothing) if conditionals are missing. can you paste package.json exports?

sam_dev: here: ```json
"exports": {
  ".": "./dist/index.js",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}```

sam_dev: build uses tsup -> outputs cjs and esm under `dist/cjs` and `dist/esm` but publish step simplified exports to a single file. :facepalm:

tyler_sdk: yeah that will break ESM consumers and edge. Node conditional exports should distinguish import/require and also point `types`. Minimal fix:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
},
"types": "dist/index.d.ts"
```

mira_ts: also add the `types` path under the `.` export if you want type-aware bundlers to resolve: some bundlers expect "types" inside the conditional entry. example: "typings": "./dist/index.d.ts" or "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" at top-level.

jenny_pm: this is causing onboarding friction — new users hit the sample app and get a cryptic TS error when following the quickstart. we need a patch release + update to the quickstart notes (call out node & edge compatibility).

ops_bot: deploy-failure: staging-edge/quickstart-sample (commit 9a3f) — runtime error: ModuleNotFoundError: Cannot find module '/workspace/node_modules/@our/sdk/dist/index.js'

sam_dev: workaround for now: pin SDK to 2.2.7 in the template and add a postinstall script that copies `dist/esm` -> `dist` for edge if you must. ugly but unblocks demos.

tyler_sdk: I'm pushing a hotfix branch that restores conditional exports and re-enables publishing both cjs+esm artifacts. Also checking our tsup config that may have stripped `d.ts` outputs from the published tarball.

mira_ts: can we add a CI job matrix that installs the package in three ways: (1) `require()` in Node CJS, (2) ESM `import` in node --experimental-modules, (3) edge runtime (bun/deno/edge shim)? quick automation would catch these regressions early.

jenny_pm: +1. also add a note in onboarding: "If you see `Cannot find module` on edge, make sure your package manager didn't flatten `dist` — pin SDK or use our patched template".

tyler_sdk: action items I will take: 1) revert exports to conditional map + include types in exports 2) republish 2.3.1 with both artifacts 3) add CI matrix for import/require/edge 4) update quickstart template to pin to 2.2.7 until 2.3.1 is live. assigning to myself now. @jenny_pm can you draft the quickstart copy update?

jenny_pm: will do, filing a docs PR today.

mira_ts: thanks — putting a note in the SDK changelog about export map and edge compatibility so integrators know what changed.

sam_dev: thanks team — hotfix will let us unpin the templates. please also add a short troubleshooting snippet to the sample README showing how to check `package.json` exports and e.g. `node -p "require.resolve('@our/sdk')"`.

tyler_sdk: will add that. closing the loop once 2.3.1 is published. :thumbsup:
